approach: Rename in expand-and-contract order so old and new code can run side by side through the rolling deploy: add the new column, keep both in step, move the readers, then drop the old one.

steps.description: Add a migration that adds an `email` column to the `users` table alongside `email_address`, with the same NOT NULL and UNIQUE constraints deferred until the backfill completes.
Backfill `email` from `email_address` for every existing row, and keep both columns in step for the duration of the deploy so instances running either version read a correct value.
Update every reader query in the repository and the notifications module to select and insert `email` instead of `email_address`.
Once every instance runs the new code, drop the old `email_address` column and its index in a follow-up migration.

risks: Dropping the old column before the deploy finishes breaks the instances still reading it.
